title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We're thrilled to officially launch Spyglass, empowering you with unprecedented visibility and deeper insights to make smarter decisions.

title: Complete Control Over Your Files
summary: Now you can effortlessly upload, manage, and precisely control how all your files and images appear directly within the editor, giving you more power over your content.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: We've launched a brand new public roadmap page where you can easily see our recently completed updates, what's coming next, and what we're planning for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes for Effortless Task Management
summary: We've significantly upgraded your checkboxes, making them bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable for a more intuitive and efficient way to manage your tasks.

title: Enhanced Team Collaboration
summary: We've significantly upgraded the editing experience to make working with your team smoother and more intuitive, ensuring everyone stays effortlessly in sync.

title: Effortless Collaboration: Find and Share What Matters
summary: We've made it even easier to share your ideas and discover relevant content from your network, fostering seamless collaboration and connection.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: Noeko is embracing open source to empower our community with greater control, direct involvement, and full transparency in shaping the future of the project.

title: Noeko Speaks Your Language
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we expand our platform with comprehensive international support.

title: Transform Your Workspace with Vibrant New Themes
summary: We are enhancing our current themes and adding a diverse range of new, visually stunning options to help you personalize your workspace.

title: Unlock New Insights with an Enhanced Constellation View
summary: Experience a transformed Constellation view, empowering you to explore your knowledge base with powerful new filtering by tags and time, and effortlessly manage your shared items and connections.

title: Enhanced Search & Custom Collections
summary: Effortlessly narrow down your information with advanced filters and save your perfect search results as custom collections, transforming how you access and organize your knowledge.

title: Dynamic Content Previews
summary: Effortlessly structure your thoughts and enhance note navigation with dynamic, interactive previews for linked content.

title: Noeko: Flexible Hosting & Premium Plans
summary: We are excited to introduce flexible paid plans and self-hosting capabilities for Noeko, empowering you with ultimate control and customizable solutions for your data.

title: Enhanced Time-Based Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more precise and personalized welcome as we update our greetings to always reflect the correct time of day.

title: Effortless Tag Management & Bulk Actions
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged items and streamline your workflow by performing bulk actions like unapplying tags directly from your lists.

title: Bring All Your Information Together
summary: Soon, you'll be able to effortlessly integrate information from a wider range of sources, including videos, web pages, and plain text, enriching your knowledge base like never before.
